question: Which of the following was NOT a method of communication in earlier times in India?

options.text: Giving indications with smoke or fire signals

solution:
The correct answer is __**Through e-mail.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Communication **is the process of **receiving **or **conveying **different kinds of **information**.
 
• In the distant **past**, **humans served as messengers, **and **pigeons, smoke signals, **and **travelling on the backs of animals **were all utilised as forms of communication.
 
• The **modern forms **of communication include **telephones**, **emails**, **newspapers, the internet, etc.**
 
• The **speed **of **modern communication **is **greater **than that of **traditional communication**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Talking or producing **sounds**,** creating pictures** with **paint **or other **visual **media**, dancing, acting, **and **utilising symbols **are some of the **earliest methods **of human communication.
 
• **Grunting **or **other guttural noises **made at a **high **or **low pitch **could be a **warning **sign or an **indication **of **social communication.**
 
• During this time, **body language **was also a form of communication.
 
• Humans later discovered the necessity to **document **their **daily actions**, which led to the development of **written communication.**
 
• Later, this developed to fulfil the **demands **of **trading **and **exchange **of **things**.
 
• One of the earliest **civilizations **to use **symbols **for **written communication **was the ancient **Egyptians**, whose alphabet later evolved into the one we use today.
